abilities.name: Expert Combatant
abilities.description: You are trained in a specific weapon attack of your choice, such as swords, axes, or bows; or in a broader category of attacks such as light bashing weapons, light bladed weapons, light ranged weapons, medium bashing weapons, medium bladed weapons, medium ranged weapons, and so on.

abilities.name: Let Them Bleed
abilities.description: The wound bleeds; on your next turn, the foe takes 2 damage that ignores armor.

abilities.name: Gut Ripper GM intrusions
abilities.description: Your knife gets stuck in your foe and slips from your grasp. Instead of hurting your foe, you accidentally inflict a minor wound on yourself. Your knife sheath is empty and you can’t complete the attack.

Genre : Fantasy. Sous-genre : Épées & Sorcellerie. Réserves principales : Célérité.
